evidence.excerpt: Synthetic allocation used only to make the global-to-site scope transition executable.
evidence.title: Synthetic Abilene-target shipment allocation

links.confirming_evidence: A frozen manufacturing release with the same platform topology, quarter, and material-cleared package-start basis supports the complete-system range.
links.falsifying_evidence: The source topology or package-start basis differs, the source result is revised, or observed package output falls outside the linked range.
links.notes: Replaces logic-die, aggregate-HBM, package-throughput, silicon-interposer, and ABF-substrate placeholders because the frozen manufacturing result reconciles logic and supplier HBM with package starts explicitly declared material-cleared. This prevents interposer and substrate availability from being counted twice; their direct capacities remain evidence gaps.
links.resource_name: Frozen material-cleared supplier-HBM manufacturing system equivalents

links.confirming_evidence: Customer allocation, purchase-order, logistics, or receiving records support this share of the frozen manufacturing flow moving to the selected site.
links.falsifying_evidence: Allocation or receiving records show a materially different site share or that the manufacturing source covers a different supply scope.
links.notes: Creates the explicit scope transition from the selected manufacturing flow to a synthetic Abilene-target shipped subset. It is not an observed customer allocation.

platform_allocation.confirming_evidence: Dated customer allocation and site receiving records support a six-percent central share for the same supply population.
platform_allocation.falsifying_evidence: Shipment destinations, purchase orders, or receiving logs put the selected site's share outside four to eight percent.
platform_allocation.methodology: Synthetic share chosen only to exercise a customer-and-site allocation boundary between manufacturing and deployment.

links.confirming_evidence: A frozen site-operational release for the same site, platform class, and quarter supports the operational-rack range.
links.falsifying_evidence: The site scope or rack class differs, the source result is revised, or rack-level acceptance records fall outside the range.
links.notes: Replaces separate illustrative power and commissioning constraints because the frozen operational result already takes their minimum after site deductions.

scenario.name: GB200 material-cleared supplier-HBM-to-Abilene chain demonstrator
scenario.notes: Frozen draw-linked material-cleared manufacturing and site-operational results replace overlapping synthetic constraints. The material-coverage definition, site share, and remaining capacity inputs are synthetic.
scenario.scope_notes: Accelerator-package through rack-integration outputs represent the selected illustrative Blackwell supply flow after supplier HBM replaces aggregate HBM and material-cleared package starts absorb interposer and substrate availability once. A shipped-stage synthetic allocation narrows later output to the Abilene-target subset. Direct interposer and substrate capacity, supplier economics, consensus, opportunity ranking, and customer allocation remain outside this run.

datacenter_operational.scope: One selected Abilene campus target-platform operational envelope.

manufacturing.scope: Illustrative Blackwell manufacturing flow with exact supplier HBM draws and synthetic material-cleared package starts that absorb silicon interposer and ABF substrate availability.
